bio.text: Michael Echols is a Republican who represents District 14 in the Louisiana House of Representatives, to which he was elected in 2019.
He qualified in August 2026 as a candidate for Louisiana's 5th Congressional District.
He holds a B.S. in accounting and an M.B.A. from the University of Louisiana Monroe.
He served on the Monroe City Council from 2016 to 2020, including as chair, and is co-owner of The Hotel Monroe; the House Republican Caucus elected him its majority leader in December 2025.
